text: Roll 1d6. On 1-2, teleport to a random revealed room.
Roll 1d6. On 4-6, discard an item if you have one.
Roll 1d6. On 1-2, discard a Clue Token if you have one.
Roll 1d6. On 1, summon a Monster in your room.
If your Sanity is 3 or less, lose 1 additional Sanity.
Shuffle one face-down Encounter Card in your room back into the deck.
If you have no items, lose 1 Health.
Discard 1 Clue Token if you're holding any.
Move to the nearest revealed room away from all players.
You may move up to 2 spaces immediately.
All monsters move 1 space toward the nearest player.
Spawn 1 Monster in an adjacent space.
All players must reroll their next action.
